answer: In March 2026, an improvised explosive device was attempted to be ignited near a Bank of America building in Paris, France. FINAL: improvised explosive device

hits.text: 28 March – A man is detained and another is at large after trying to ignite an improvised explosive device near a Bank of America building in Paris.
One person is killed and 14 others are injured in a gas explosion and multiple-alarm fire at a 17-story apartment building in the Bronx, New York City.
13 July – A major wildfire breaks out at Fontainebleau forest.
A wildfire fire breaks out in Landes, displacing 650 people.
July 7 – Two explosive devices near the Four Seasons Hotel Damascus explode, wounding at least 18 people. It is alleged to be an attempted assassination of Emmanuel Macron.
